cues.en: Mike: In this video, I'm going to show you how to implement a one-way ANOVA for independent samples.
cues.zh: Mike：這支影片示範如何實作獨立樣本的單因子 ANOVA。

cues.en: So this is not a repeated measures ANOVA.
cues.zh: 不是重複量測 ANOVA。

cues.en: It's important for me to point this out because the code that I'm going to show you here is a bit of a simplification that works only for one-way ANOVA.
cues.zh: 要特別指出，因為這裡展示的程式碼是簡化方式，只適用於單因子 ANOVA。

cues.en: Okay, so let's begin by setting up the parameters for simulating the data.
cues.zh: 先設定模擬資料的參數。

cues.en: I'm going to generate data from three different groups.
cues.zh: 要產生三個不同群組的資料。

cues.en: So maybe this is, you know, three different age groups or three different medications, three different movie genres.
cues.zh: 可能是三個年齡組、三種藥物，或三種電影類型。

cues.en: It can be whatever you like.
cues.zh: 你可以自行想像。

cues.en: And here's what I specified the means to be.
cues.zh: 這裡指定各組平均值。

cues.en: So you can see group one and group two are gonna have pretty similar means.
cues.zh: 第一組與第二組的平均值會很相似。

cues.en: And group three is a bit further apart.
cues.zh: 第三組則比較遠。

cues.en: And here I'm generating three different sample sizes.
cues.zh: 這裡產生三個不同樣本大小。

cues.en: And this is just to illustrate to you that we can have different sample sizes within our ANOVA context.
cues.zh: 只是為了示範，ANOVA 可以有不同樣本大小。

cues.en: Here I'm specifying the standard deviation, so the individual variability within each group.
cues.zh: 這裡指定標準差，也就是各組內的個體變異。

cues.en: And for convenience, I'm assuming that all groups have the same variance.
cues.zh: 為了方便，假設所有組別變異數相同。

cues.en: But of course you can change this if you like.
cues.zh: 當然，想改也可以。

cues.en: You could set it up to be like this so that the different groups have different variances.
cues.zh: 可以設成這樣，讓不同組別有不同變異數。

cues.en: Totally fine. Okay, so run this and here's where I actually simulate the data, and now I'm using this function, RNG.
cues.zh: 都可以。執行，這裡真正模擬資料，現在使用 rng 函式。

cues.en: That might be a new function to you.
cues.zh: 你可能沒看過這個函式。

cues.en: RNG is for random number generator.
cues.zh: rng 代表隨機數產生器。

cues.en: The idea of this function is that we can input a specific number and on my computer that's going to reproduce exactly the same sequence of random numbers.
cues.zh: 概念是，輸入特定數字，就能在我的電腦上，重現完全相同的隨機數序列。

cues.en: So I guess then we have to call it Pseudorandom Numbers.
cues.zh: 那或許應該稱為偽隨機數。

cues.en: So to illustrate that to you, I'm going to, let's see, I'll run this code.
cues.zh: 實際示範，執行這段程式碼。

cues.en: I'm gonna just delete that semicolon at the end so that it prints out the third dataset.
cues.zh: 刪掉最後的分號，讓它印出第三份資料集。

cues.en: So this is the third dataset and these are numbers that are randomly generated of course, but now I can run this again and you can see each time I run this cell,
cues.zh: 這是第三份資料集，當然是隨機產生的數字。但再執行一次，就可以看到，每次執行儲存格，

cues.en: I'm getting exactly the same sequence of random numbers.
cues.zh: 都得到完全相同的隨機數序列。

cues.en: That's because of I'm setting the random number generator.
cues.zh: 因為設定了隨機數產生器。

cues.en: I can change this to be four.
cues.zh: 可以改成 4。

cues.en: And now watch what happens down here when I run the code, we get different random numbers, but now when I run this code, again, it's the same different random numbers.
cues.zh: 再執行時注意下面，得到不同隨機數；但再執行一次，又會是同一組不同的隨機數。

cues.en: So this is just a useful way to see the random number process in case you want to be able to reproduce your own results over and over
cues.zh: 這是了解隨機數流程的一個有用方式，如果想要反覆重現結果，

cues.en: and over again using random numbers that are repeatable.
cues.zh: 就能使用可重複的隨機數。

cues.en: Okay, anyway, so now there's two methods for organizing the data into a matrix or a vector for the one-way ANOVA to work.
cues.zh: 為了讓單因子 ANOVA 運作，有兩種方式把資料整理成矩陣或向量。

cues.en: So first I'm gonna show you one way to organize the data.
cues.zh: 先示範第一種資料整理方式。

cues.en: And the way that I'm going to do this is by vertically stacking.
cues.zh: 採用垂直堆疊。

cues.en: So concatenating these three data vectors.
cues.zh: 把三個資料向量串接起來。

cues.en: So that's gonna give us one long data vector.
cues.zh: 得到一條很長的資料向量。

cues.en: You can see this one is 30 data points, this one is 35 data points, 29 data points.
cues.zh: 這個有 30 點，這個 35 點，這個 29 點。

cues.en: And this vector, all data has 94 data points.
cues.zh: all data 向量共有 94 個資料點。

cues.en: Now, of course, we need a way to know which values correspond to which group.
cues.zh: 當然，需要知道哪些數值屬於哪個群組。

cues.en: So that's what I do here.
cues.zh: 這裡就是在做這件事。

cues.en: So I create this new variable called group labels, and I'm stacking ones and then two times ones and then three times ones.
cues.zh: 建立稱為 group labels 的新變數，先堆疊一組 1，再兩倍的一組 1，再三倍的一組 1。

cues.en: So this gives us, this gives us the way of specifying which group, which data point belongs to which group.
cues.zh: 如此指定每個資料點屬於哪個群組。

cues.en: Now, just a quick note here, you could also do this with string labels or text labels like this.
cues.zh: 快速補充，也可以用這樣的字串標籤或文字標籤。

cues.en: Let me just show you what this is going to look like.
cues.zh: 先示範它會是什麼樣子。

cues.en: So I'm just, you know, coming up with these random group labels here.
cues.zh: 我隨意想一些群組標籤。

cues.en: Now the one thing to be mindful of is that in this function that I'm gonna use here, the function ANOVA One, the group labels can be numeric or they can be strings.
cues.zh: 要注意的是，這裡使用的 anova1 函式，群組標籤可以是數字，也可以是字串。

cues.en: So it's totally fine here.
cues.zh: 所以這裡完全沒問題。

cues.en: However, in the next several code videos.
cues.zh: 但接下來幾支程式影片，

cues.en: So for one-way repeated measures in ANOVA and for a multifactorial in ANOVA, it's actually not possible to use numbers as group labels.
cues.zh: 單因子重複量測 ANOVA 與多因子 ANOVA，不能使用數字當群組標籤。

cues.en: Instead, you need to use strings.
cues.zh: 必須使用字串。

cues.en: So this sort of approach is necessary for more complicated ANOVA models.
cues.zh: 更複雜的 ANOVA 模型，就需要這種方式。

cues.en: And the numbers are fine for a one-way ANOVA as long as you're using this function ANOVA One.
cues.zh: 單因子 ANOVA 只要使用 anova1 函式，就可以用數字。

cues.en: Okay, anyway, here's where we run the ANOVA.
cues.zh: 這裡執行 ANOVA。

cues.en: Here we input all of the data, all the group labels, and this third optional input on means to activate a graphic.
cues.zh: 輸入所有資料、所有群組標籤，第三個選用輸入 on 表示開啟圖形。

cues.en: So we'll get a graphical display of the results.
cues.zh: 所以會以圖形顯示結果。

cues.en: This is actually the default value.
cues.zh: 這其實是預設值。

cues.en: So it's just here to remind me.
cues.zh: 放在這裡只是提醒自己。

cues.en: And then we're gonna get a couple of outputs here.
cues.zh: 接著取得幾個輸出。

cues.en: The P value, the full ANOVA table, this is what we're mostly interested in, and then some additional information here.
cues.zh: P 值、完整 ANOVA 表，這是主要關心的，以及一些額外資訊。

cues.en: Okay, so here we get to actually two figures.
cues.zh: 這裡其實得到兩張圖。

cues.en: This one has really small font, but this is the ANOVA table.
cues.zh: 這張字很小，但就是 ANOVA 表。

cues.en: So let me print this out for you here.
cues.zh: 在這裡印出來給你看。

cues.en: This is variable ANOVA table.
cues.zh: 這是 ANOVA table 變數。

cues.en: So you see it's a cell array, so a matrix of cells, but this is exactly the same table setup that I showed in the slides.
cues.zh: 它是 cell array，也就是儲存格陣列，但表格格式與投影片完全相同。

cues.en: So we have the source of the variability, whether it's the groups or the error, which I call within.
cues.zh: 有變異來源，群組或誤差，後者我稱為組內。

cues.en: And here's the total.
cues.zh: 這是總計。

cues.en: And then we have the sumo squared errors, degrees of freedom, the mean square, the F ratio, and the P value, which here is called the probability
cues.zh: 接著有平方誤差和、自由度、均方、F 比值，以及 P 值，這裡稱為

cues.en: of having an observed F statistic greater than, or sorry, the probability of having an F statistic larger than what we actually observed in the data,
cues.zh: 觀察到的 F 統計量大於——抱歉，是 F 統計量大於資料中實際觀察值的機率，

cues.en: which is this value here.
cues.zh: 也就是這裡的值。

cues.en: And then, you know, it's always nice to look at the degrees of freedom column, particularly when you're just running code for the first time.
cues.zh: 查看自由度欄總是很好，尤其第一次執行程式碼時。

cues.en: You know, you're just setting up a new model for the first time, it's really easy to make a simple typo, or maybe you didn't understand exactly how to set up the model.
cues.zh: 第一次設定新模型，很容易打錯字，或不完全理解如何設定模型。

cues.en: So you should always check the degrees of freedom to make sure that they give you the right answer.
cues.zh: 所以應該檢查自由度，確保答案正確。

cues.en: So we already know for certainly for one-way ANOVA it's pretty easy.
cues.zh: 單因子 ANOVA 很容易，我們已經知道，

cues.en: We have the total degrees of freedom is N minus one.
cues.zh: 總自由度是 N 減 1。

cues.en: So there's 94 data points in total.
cues.zh: 所以總共有 94 個資料點。

cues.en: And then the groups, well, we have three groups.
cues.zh: 組別方面，有三組。

cues.en: And so the number of degrees of freedom here is going to be three minus one, which is two.
cues.zh: 自由度就會是 3 減 1，等於 2。

cues.en: Okay, so that's very good.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: So we get, and then this table here in this figure is just a repeat of these numbers here.
cues.zh: 這張圖中的表格，只是重複這裡的數字。

cues.en: Okay, very small font for some reason.
cues.zh: 不知為何字體很小。

cues.en: Okay, and then we get here, we see the data.
cues.zh: 接著看到資料。

cues.en: So we got these box plots of the data.
cues.zh: 得到資料的盒形圖。

cues.en: So this is Group One, Group Two, and Group Three.
cues.zh: 第一組、第二組與第三組。

cues.en: And this also conforms with the means that we specified.
cues.zh: 也符合指定的平均值。

cues.en: So we said this one should be four, this one should be 3.8, and this one should be seven.
cues.zh: 這組應該是 4，這組 3.8，這組 7。

cues.en: All right, so now we get to the problem again, of which groups are actually are different from which other ones.
cues.zh: 現在又回到問題：哪些群組實際上與哪些群組不同？

cues.en: It kind of, you know, looking at this, it seems like this is different from these other two, but we don't actually know that for sure.
cues.zh: 看起來這組與另外兩組不同，但還不能確定。

cues.en: I'm just guessing based on visual inspection here.
cues.zh: 我只是根據目視檢查猜測。

cues.en: So now I'm going to run this function called Multcompare.
cues.zh: 接著執行 multcompare 函式。

cues.en: And I'm gonna input this stats structure here, this statistics object that is outputted by ANOVA One.
cues.zh: 輸入這個 stats 結構，也就是 anova1 輸出的統計物件。

cues.en: So let's run this and then we get, actually, let me do it again without the semicolon here so we can see the output.
cues.zh: 執行，再把分號去掉重做一次，看看輸出。

cues.en: Okay, so first of all, we get this figure that opened up, which is pretty neat actually.
cues.zh: 首先，打開了這張圖，相當不錯。

cues.en: So it says, click on the group you want to test.
cues.zh: 它說，點選想檢驗的群組。

cues.en: So we have Group One, Group Two, and Group Three.
cues.zh: 有第一組、第二組與第三組。

cues.en: And these are the means here.
cues.zh: 這裡是平均值。

cues.en: So this is a little bit like the box plot, except that it's horizontally oriented instead of vertically oriented.
cues.zh: 有點像盒形圖，只是改成水平，而非垂直方向。

cues.en: So Group One, Group Two, Group Three.
cues.zh: 第一組、第二組、第三組。

cues.en: And now what we can do is click on these different groups.
cues.zh: 現在可以點選不同群組。

cues.en: I hope it, the lines are a little thin.
cues.zh: 線有點細，希望，

cues.en: I hope you can see the lines that this one is blue, this is now light gray, and this one is red.
cues.zh: 希望你看得出來，這條是藍色，這條現在是淺灰，這條是紅色。

cues.en: So as I'm clicking around on these, MATLAB is returning that the means of Groups Two and Three are significantly different.
cues.zh: 點選時，MATLAB 回報第二組與第三組的平均值有顯著差異。

cues.en: Here I'm testing one against three.
cues.zh: 這裡檢驗第一組與第三組。

cues.en: And here you can actually keep clicking around until you manage to pin groups together.
cues.zh: 這裡可以持續點選，直到把群組固定在一起。

cues.en: So this is saying that Groups One and Two together pooled are significantly different from Group Three.
cues.zh: 這表示第一組與第二組合在一起，與第三組顯著不同。

cues.en: So the output of the Multcompare function is a matrix that looks like this.
cues.zh: multcompare 的輸出，是像這樣的矩陣。

cues.en: And I admit that I always have to open up this file and check out the help text to remember what this means.
cues.zh: 得承認，我總是要打開這個檔案，查看說明文字，才記得各欄的意思。

cues.en: But, so we have the first two columns here.
cues.zh: 前兩欄，

cues.en: This is telling us which two groups are being compared.
cues.zh: 表示正在比較哪兩個群組。

cues.en: So this row is gonna be Group One versus Group Two.
cues.zh: 這一列是第一組相對於第二組。

cues.en: This row here is Group One versus Group Three.
cues.zh: 這一列是第一組相對於第三組。

cues.en: And this is for Two versus Three.
cues.zh: 這是第二組相對於第三組。

cues.en: And then here we have the parameter estimate of the difference between the two groups.
cues.zh: 這裡是兩組差異的參數估計值。

cues.en: And then here's the lower bound, so the lower confidence bound and the upper confidence bound.
cues.zh: 這是下界，也就是信賴下界，以及信賴上界。

cues.en: And this column is what we care about.
cues.zh: 這一欄是我們關心的。

cues.en: This is the P value here.
cues.zh: 這裡是 P 值。

cues.en: So comparing Groups One and Two, we see that the P value is basically one, so they don't differ at all.

cues.en: And then we see that the comparing Groups One and Three leads to a P value that's really small, much, well less than 0.0001.
cues.zh: 比較第一組與第三組，P 值非常小，遠小於 0.0001。

cues.en: And also comparing Groups Two and Three is also statistically significant.
cues.zh: 第二組與第三組，也有統計顯著差異。

cues.en: All right? So this is one way of setting up the data for using the function ANOVA One, there's a second method
cues.zh: 這是為 anova1 整理資料的一種方式，還有第二種，

cues.en: for organizing the data, and I wanna show you that quickly.
cues.zh: 想快速示範。

cues.zh: 矩陣像這樣。

cues.en: So this is Group One, Group Two, and Group Three.
cues.zh: 這是第一組、第二組與第三組。

cues.en: So the code looks really similar.

cues.zh: 方便比較這裡與上面的結果，但它們相同。

cues.en: I'm gonna use the function in this module to compute the one-way ANOVA.
cues.zh: 使用這個模組的函式，計算單因子 ANOVA。

cues.en: So what we're gonna do here is generate some data, and I'm gonna generate the data as random numbers for three different groups with these three different means.
cues.zh: 產生資料，用這三個平均值，為三個不同群組產生隨機數。

cues.en: So Group One is gonna have a mean of four, Group Two a mean of 3.8 and Group Three with a mean of seven.
cues.zh: 第一組平均值 4，第二組 3.8，第三組 7。

cues.en: Here I'm specifying different sample sizes for the different groups.
cues.zh: 這裡指定各組不同樣本數。

cues.en: And there's no particular reason to do this except just to illustrate to you that the code is flexible enough to handle different sample sizes.
cues.zh: 沒有特別原因，只是示範程式碼夠靈活，可以處理不同樣本數。

cues.en: And here I'm specifying a common standard deviation to use across all groups.
cues.zh: 這裡指定各組共用的標準差。

cues.en: So all groups are gonna have the same variance.
cues.zh: 所有組別的變異數相同。

cues.en: Now there's no particular reason to set it up that way, it's just how I wrote the code.
cues.zh: 沒有特別理由，只是我這樣寫程式碼。

cues.en: You can certainly make the standard deviation term be different for each of the three groups.
cues.zh: 當然也可以讓三組各自有不同的標準差項。

cues.en: Okay, so here I am simulating the data.
cues.zh: 這裡模擬資料。

cues.en: So you can see it's just normally distributed random numbers that are stretched according to the standard deviation and shifted according to the mean.
cues.zh: 就是常態分布隨機數，依標準差拉伸，依平均值平移。

cues.en: So the way that I am setting up these data is as a pandas data frame.
cues.zh: 我用 Pandas DataFrame 來整理資料。

cues.en: And I'm organizing these data to be one long vector.
cues.zh: 把資料排成一條長向量。
